# BrandexVideo

> BrandexVideo is a remote short-form video editing service for creators, coaches, doctors, entrepreneurs and brands. We edit, colour grade, caption and publish Instagram Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts within 24–48 hours. Serving the USA, UK, UAE, Canada, Australia and worldwide. Based in Chennai, India.

## What we do

- Short-form and b-roll video editing: Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts — every video up to 60 seconds
- Cinema-grade colour grading
- Animated word-by-word captions
- Motion graphics, animated titles, lower thirds, logo reveals
- Thumbnail design
- Direct publishing to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and Facebook with SEO titles, hashtags and peak-time scheduling

## Pricing (USD, monthly, cancel anytime, no setup fee)

- Starter: $799/month — 10 videos (each up to 60 sec), colour grading, captions, music, 2 platforms, 48hr turnaround, unlimited revisions
- Growth: $1,499/month — 20 videos, cinematic grading, motion graphics, 4 platforms, thumbnails, 24hr turnaround, dedicated editor
- Scale: $2,799/month — 40 videos, full post-production, all platforms, 12hr priority turnaround, editor + colorist, monthly strategy calls

How videos are counted: one video = up to 60 seconds of finished output. A 90-second or 2-minute video counts as two videos.

## How it works

1. Upload raw footage to a shared Google Drive folder we set up for you
2. A dedicated editor cuts, grades, captions and adds graphics using your brand kit
3. You review and leave timestamped comments — unlimited revisions included
4. We schedule and publish to your social accounts at peak time

## Who we serve

Content creators and YouTubers, entrepreneurs and founders, coaches and course creators, doctors and medical professionals, consultants and advisors, brands and businesses.

## Countries served

United States, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates, Canada, Australia, India, and worldwide. Fully remote and asynchronous — time zones are not a barrier.

## Editing styles (pick a look)

- [Bold Caption Style Video Editing](https://www.brandexvideo.com/styles/bold-caption-style): Bold captions, punch-ins, zero dead air
- [Clean Educator Style Video Editing](https://www.brandexvideo.com/styles/clean-educator-style): Calm pacing, tidy graphics, one lesson per video
- [Fast-Cut Entertainment Style Video Editing](https://www.brandexvideo.com/styles/fast-cut-entertainment-style): Rapid cuts, SFX on everything, never a still frame
- [Cinematic Talking-Head Style Video Editing](https://www.brandexvideo.com/styles/cinematic-talking-head-style): Shallow depth, moody grade, slow b-roll, premium feel

- [Motivational Speaker Style Video Editing](https://www.brandexvideo.com/styles/motivational-speaker-style): Stage footage, epic music, big text, emotional arc

## Blog

- [Blog index](https://www.brandexvideo.com/blog/): Guides on short-form editing, pricing and creator growth
- [How Much Does Short-Form Video Editing Cost in 2026?](https://www.brandexvideo.com/blog/short-form-video-editing-cost-2026): Freelancer $50–150/clip, studios $80–95, subscriptions $799–2,799/month for 10–40 videos. Per-video pricing stops making sense at ~5 videos/month.
- [Reels vs TikTok vs YouTube Shorts: What to Edit Differently in 2026](https://www.brandexvideo.com/blog/reels-vs-tiktok-vs-shorts-editing-differences): All three use a 1080×1920 canvas, but TikTok blocks the right 120px and bottom 320px, Reels blocks the bottom 310px, and Shorts hides the bottom 300px.
- [Why Doctors Are Hiring Video Editors in 2026](https://www.brandexvideo.com/blog/why-doctors-are-hiring-video-editors): 94% of patients check a doctor online before booking, yet 53% of physicians have no personal brand. Short-form video is closing that gap.
- [Freelancer vs Agency vs Subscription: Which Video Editing Model Is Right for You?](https://www.brandexvideo.com/blog/freelancer-vs-agency-vs-subscription-video-editing): Freelancers cost $50–150 per video but stall when they are busy. Agencies start at $2,500/month and include strategy. Subscriptions run $799–2,799/month with a dedicated editor.
- [The Anatomy of a 60-Second Video: Why the First 3 Seconds Decide Everything](https://www.brandexvideo.com/blog/anatomy-of-a-60-second-video-hook): Viewers decide to scroll or stay within 1.7–3 seconds.
- [How Remote Video Editing Works: Sending Footage, Reviewing Cuts, Publishing From Anywhere](https://www.brandexvideo.com/blog/how-remote-video-editing-works): Remote video editing works through a shared Google Drive folder, timestamped review comments and direct publishing to your accounts.
- [How Much Does It Cost to Edit a TikTok Video in 2026?](https://www.brandexvideo.com/blog/how-much-to-edit-a-tiktok-video): Editing one TikTok costs $25–75 (beginner), $75–200 (experienced freelancer), $200–500 (specialist) or $70–80 per video inside a 10–40 video monthly plan. Rush delivery adds 20–40%; per-video pricing stops making sense above ~5 videos/month.
- [Instagram Reels Editing Price: What You Pay Per Video in 2026](https://www.brandexvideo.com/blog/instagram-reels-editing-price-per-video): Editing one Instagram Reel costs $25–75 (beginner), $75–200 (experienced freelancer), $200–500 (specialist/agency) or $70–80 per Reel inside a 10–40 video monthly plan. Rush adds 20–40% on freelance quotes; plans beat per-Reel pricing above ~5 Reels a month.
- [Video Editor Hourly Rate vs Per-Video Pricing: Which Costs Less?](https://www.brandexvideo.com/blog/video-editor-hourly-rate-vs-per-video): 2026 video editor hourly rates: $20–45 beginner, $45–85 mid-level, $85–150 senior, $100–250 agency. A 60-second short takes 2–4 hours, so hourly costs $90–340 per clip vs $75–200 flat per video or $70–80 in a 10–40 video monthly plan; per-video wins above ~5 videos a month.
